thought.text: Tenant creation returns an empty body (201). I need to list tenants to get the id.

reasoning_content:
The tenant creation returns "Created" and 201 with an empty body. So the tenant ID is not in the response. I need another way to get the tenant ID. Let me list the tenants via `GET /api/tenants` (authenticated). That returns the list of tenants visible to the user.

Let me fix the seed script to fetch the tenant list after creation.

action.command:
cd /tmp && cat > seed2.sh <<'EOF'
#!/bin/bash
set -e
API=http://localhost:8081
PY='docker run --rm -i display-server:latest python'
TOKEN=$(curl -s -X POST $API/auth/signin -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -d '{"id":"admin","password":"admin"}' | $PY -c 'import sys,json;print(json.load(sys.stdin)["accessToken"])')

# list tenants to find the one we just created
TENANT_ID=$(curl -s $API/api/tenants -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" | $PY -c 'import sys,json;d=json.load(sys.stdin);t=d if isinstance(d,list) else d.get("tenants",[]);print(t[-1]["id"] if t else "")')
echo "tenant_id=$TENANT_ID"

# check if a bookable already exists (from failed run) -> skip creation if so
EXISTING=$(curl -s $API/api/$TENANT_ID/bookables -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" | $PY -c 'import sys,json;d=json.load(sys.stdin);b=d if isinstance(d,list) else [];print(b[0]["id"] if b else "")')
echo "existing_bookable=$EXISTING"
if [ -z "$EXISTING" ]; then
  BOOKABLE_ID=$(curl -s -X POST $API/api/$TENANT_ID/bookables -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
    -d '{"title":"Raum A","type":"room","isPublic":true,"isBookable":true,"isScheduleRelated":true,"isTimePeriodRelated":true,"amount":1,"maxAmountPerBooking":1,"minBookingDuration":15,"maxBookingDuration":480}' | $PY -c 'import sys,json;print(json.load(sys.stdin)["id"])')
else
  BOOKABLE_ID=$EXISTING
fi
echo "bookable_id=$BOOKABLE_ID"

NOW=$(date +%s%3N)
BEGIN=$(( (NOW/1000 + 3600) * 1000 ))
END=$(( (NOW/1000 + 3600 + 7200) * 1000 ))
echo "booking window (ms): begin=$BEGIN end=$END"
echo "booking resp:"
curl -s -X POST $API/api/$TENANT_ID/bookings -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -d "{\"timeBegin\":$BEGIN,\"timeEnd\":$END,\"bookableItems\":[{\"bookableId\":\"$BOOKABLE_ID\",\"amount\":1}],\"name\":\"Max Mustermann\",\"mail\":\"max@example.com\",\"company\":\"Muster GmbH\",\"status\":\"confirmed\"}" | head -c 800
echo
{ echo "TENANT_ID=$TENANT_ID"; echo "BOOKABLE_ID=$BOOKABLE_ID"; } > /tmp/seed.env
echo "saved /tmp/seed.env"
EOF
bash seed2.sh
